CODE-REPORT.description: Steel Code Check Report (CODE-REPORT) for AIJ-ASD02. The request (wrapped in Argument) selects report type, export destination, mode, and element/section selection. SIDE EFFECT: writes the report file (e.g. .xlsx) on the HOST machine running MIDAS, at the path built from EXPORT_PATH + OUTPUT_NAME in the request - the client never receives the file, only its path. Prerequisites: analysis results and AIJ-ASD02 code-check results must exist (run PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO, analysis, then CODE-ANAL first); with no design results the request fails in-band with 'No design results found for the requested elements/sections.' (HTTP 200 error body, not an HTTP error). Runs synchronously - a large selection can exceed the ~60s client read timeout. For steel a report mode is effectively required: MEMB reports use CURRENT_MODE_MEMB (falling back to CURRENT_MODE), PROP reports use CURRENT_MODE_PROP (falling back to CURRENT_MODE); if neither is assigned the request fails. Response: {SUCCESS, FILE_PATH (generated file full path on the host), MESSAGE}.

REPORT_TYPE.description: Report Type: MEMB (by member) or PROP (by section property). Case-insensitive.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export Path on the HOST machine (e.g. C:\MIDAS\Report\). The report file is written there, not returned to the client.

CURRENT_MODE.description: Report Mode fallback used when the type-specific mode field is not assigned. Case-insensitive. For steel, set this (or the matching CURRENT_MODE_MEMB/CURRENT_MODE_PROP) - omitting all mode fields fails the request.

CURRENT_MODE_MEMB.description: [REPORT_TYPE=MEMB] Report Mode; takes precedence over CURRENT_MODE. Case-insensitive.

CURRENT_MODE_PROP.description: [REPORT_TYPE=PROP] Report Mode; takes precedence over CURRENT_MODE. Case-insensitive.

ELEMS.description: Element Numbers selection. Combined with SECTIONS when both are given; omit both to report all designed members.

DETAIL_POSITIONS.description: Detail Print Positions (used by RC Beam Design MEMB mode; not meaningful for steel).
